method: Written from model knowledge only (no simulated nominations). Contribution-centred longlist for a merge with an independent GPT draft. Entries whose work is fully covered by an Economic Sciences prize from 1969 to 2025 are excluded (list fetched from api.nobelprize.org on 2026-10-03). Entries that border an awarded citation are kept, and 'overlap_review' names the prize and the risk; null means no material overlap. 'nominees' is a provisional credit pool of at most three living people. 'other_names' holds further credited or historical contributors, including laureates (marked) and deceased pioneers, for the merge stage to weigh. Deaths are verified and marked only for people who were moved out of a nominee pool. Living status of every nominee checked against Wikidata and English Wikipedia on 2026-10-03. Removed from nominee pools as deceased: David B. Gordon (1996), Karl-Goran Maler (2020), David Schmeidler (2022), Paul A. David (2023), Jonathan Eaton (2024), Patrick Bajari (2025), D. John Roberts (2026), Erik Thorbecke (2026). Many nominees had no usable Wikidata or Wikipedia match (mostly younger scholars). No death was found for any of them, and they are assumed living. No name anywhere in the list is a member of the 2026 Economic Sciences Prize Committee (checked against agent-data/economics/committee/ROSTER.md). Where a committee member would otherwise belong in a pool, the entry says so: Per Krusell (incomplete-markets models), Per Stromberg (private equity) and Randi Hjalmarsson (economics of crime).
